parsed.name: PQSC量子系统控制器
parsed.description: 苏黎世仪器的PQSC是一种量子系统控制器，用于在量子测控实验中统一产生和分发触发信号，通过ZSync协调多台已连接仪器，并检查参考时钟锁定与端口连接状态。
parsed.description_en: The Zurich Instruments PQSC is a quantum system controller used in quantum measurement and control setups to generate and distribute triggers, coordinate multiple connected instruments over ZSync, and verify reference clock lock and port connectivity.

actions.description: 预置PQSC以进行触发，配置执行引擎并清空寄存器，可选设置触发次数和保持时间。
actions.description_en: Arm the PQSC for triggering by configuring the execution engine and clearing registers, with optional trigger count and holdoff settings.

actions.description: 预置PQSC并立即开始发送触发信号。
actions.description_en: Arm the PQSC and immediately start sending trigger signals.

actions.description: 检查参考时钟是否已成功锁定。
actions.description_en: Check whether the reference clock has locked successfully.

actions.description: 检查指定ZSync端口上的连接是否已经建立。
actions.description_en: Check whether the ZSync connection on the specified port or ports has been established.

actions.description: 查找与指定设备相连的PQSC ZSync端口编号。
actions.description_en: Find the PQSC ZSync port ID connected to a specified device.

actions.description: 开始通过ZSync向所有已连接仪器发送触发信号。
actions.description_en: Start sending trigger signals to all connected instruments over ZSync.

actions.description: 停止触发信号的生成与输出。
等待触发生成和反馈处理完成。
actions.description_en: Wait until trigger generation and feedback processing are complete.
